subject: Supplier integration kickoff — onboarding matrix & PO prep
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Park <susan@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier integration kickoff — onboarding matrix & PO prep

Hi Susan —

Great to meet you on the call this morning. As discussed, we'd like to kick off procurement onboarding so we can get a PO issued and billing configured before your first shipment. To keep this light, I attached a single onboarding matrix (redwood_procurement_onboarding_template.xlsx) that summarizes the items we typically need and whether each item is required, optional, or pending. Can you please confirm which items you can provide this week vs. next?

At a high level we need:
- Completed W-9 or equivalent tax form (required)
- Bank details for ACH remit + signed ACH authorization (required for net-30)
- Insurance certificate naming Redwood Inference as certificate holder (required)
- Point(s) of contact for invoicing and logistics (name, title, email, phone)
- signed Master Services Agreement (MSA) or counter-signed PO terms (if you have exceptions, flag them)
- Security self-attestation (SOC2/ISO summary) or answers to our short security checklist (if available)

Questions for you:
1) Do you require a vendor portal or EDI for invoicing, or will email/PDF suffice?
2) Any special remittance notes we should include on the PO?
3) Preferred billing cadence (Net 30 / Net 45 / other)?

Next steps I propose:
- You reply with the attached items you can share and estimated delivery dates.
- We raise an internal PO once W-9 + bank remit form are received and validated.
- Laura will confirm any security/compliance gating items.
- Marissa will own the PO creation and vendor code setup.

Attachments: redwood_procurement_onboarding_template.xlsx (matrix)

Thanks — appreciate a quick reply so we can keep the timeline tight.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Partnerships & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

From: Susan Park <susan@acmelogistics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmelogistics.com
Date: 2026-07-12T11:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier integration kickoff — onboarding matrix & PO prep

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear checklist and for the call. We're aligned to move quickly. Please find the following attached: W-9_AcmeLogistics.pdf, bank_ach_form_Acme.pdf (ACH template signed), and insurance_certificate_Acme.pdf. We can provide a completed SOC2 summary next week (our compliance team is working on a redacted export).

Answers inline:
- Invoicing: Email PDF invoices to invoices@acmelogistics.com and cc procurement@acmelogistics.com. We do not require EDI for this relationship; PDFs via email are fine.
- Remittance note: Please set "Remit to Acme Logistics — ACH only" on the PO if possible.
- Billing cadence: We normally run Net 30. If Redwood requires Net 45, we can discuss.

Estimated delivery: 
- W-9/ACH/insurance: attached (today)
- SOC2 summary: 2026-07-20 EOD (tentative)
- Signed MSA: We have a standard supplier MSA; if Redwood prefers a PO-only route we can accept our terms and countersign the PO.

One additional ask: are there any mandatory data residency clauses we should be aware of? Our legal team flagged a single-line clause for EU customers but not for US vendors.

Forwarded attachments: W-9_AcmeLogistics.pdf; bank_ach_form_Acme.pdf; insurance_certificate_Acme.pdf

Best,
Susan Park
Head of Procurement
Acme Logistics
susan@acmelogistics.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-13T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Supplier integration kickoff — onboarding matrix & PO prep

Thanks Karthik — thanks Susan for the quick turnaround and attachments. I reviewed the files: W-9 and ACH look good, and insurance coverage meets our minimum requirements. Pending items: SOC2 summary and decision on MSA vs PO-only.

Karthik — I'll take ownership of raising the PO once Laura confirms compliance gating (SOC2 redaction acceptable). Proposed internal timeline:
- Today: I create a draft PO (PO-8421) with Net 30 and remit note per Acme request.
- Tomorrow: Legal to confirm MSA acceptance or redline (if any).
- EOW: PO issued and vendor code created in our AP system.

Laura — can you confirm whether the SOC2 redaction (summary) is sufficient for our standard onboarding? If legal needs a full report we'll escalate but I'd prefer the light-touch route for a logistics supplier.

I'll attach the PO draft to this thread once created.

Marissa
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Susan Park <susan@acmelogistics.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Supplier integration kickoff — onboarding matrix & PO prep

All — quick compliance update. The SOC2 summary as proposed (redacted cover + AICPA attestation excerpt) is acceptable for non-sensitive logistics vendors. No additional security gating required. Legal reviewed Acme's standard MSA and is ok with PO-only onboarding for this supplier provided the PO includes our standard indemnity and data handling appendix.

Marissa — please proceed with issuing PO-8421 (Net 30, remit to ACH). I've attached the finalized PO for signature. Susan — please confirm receipt and the exact remit-to account name matches the ACH form (we'll release payment after invoice matches PO).

Attachments: PO_8421.pdf

Thanks everyone — looks like we're set to proceed.

Laura Bennett
Head of Business Operations
Redwood Inference
